credit_rule: A week is credited only when a live (not fixture or M3 dry-run) Role 2 compare runs against timestamped Vegas snapshots with as_of <= kickoff_at and n_matched > 0. Fixture and synthetic weeks demonstrate the harness; they do not count toward 6-8. Outcomes are required for vs-actual metrics but not for the first credit of a week (model-vs-market). Re-credit is idempotent per (season, week). Gate remains not_promoting until the decision-note bar clears.
